manifest.name: Camera+
manifest.author: Zoidium
manifest.description: A separate Camera+ object for scenes, with depth of field, seeded vibrate, and focus tools. Leaves the CM3 camera unchanged.

objectClasses.name: Camera+
objectClasses.description: A scene camera with film controls, depth of field, and vibrate. Renders the scene while it is the first active Camera+ in that scene.
